local_lanes_trial.revision: dfa2878 plus worker-local transmit lane selection

pinned_control.note: Fresh tunnels each point; in-window receiver samples exclude drain.

local_lanes_final.revision: dfa2878 plus local lane selection with strict hashing for sessions using fewer queues than global workers

udp_local_final.revision: dfa2878 plus worker-local lanes limited to unfragmented UDP with all workers owning TAP queues; TCP and other traffic retain strict pinning

profile.path: disposable TAP namespaces, IPv6 loopback underlay
profile.note: One socket, physical cores without SMT siblings. No own builds or other tests during measurements.

notes: All failures retained. valid=false prevents acceptance claims, including records outside duplicate window.
Prior shared-tunnel points normalize final unique delivery by sender duration and include the receiver drain.
Missing percentage is sender sent minus final receiver unique; the receive window is finite.
Daemon CPU uses before/sent process ticks. Receiver CPU in the historical summary is normalized by sender duration; receiver CPU seconds and elapsed seconds are also retained.
TAP TX drops can count super-frame SKBs with USO input; do not interpret these as logical frame counts.
